steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Miss Ela? What brings you here?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Where is Reynell?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: He's playing golf on the balcony...

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Wait, Miss Ela!

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: My apologies... Did the shot just now hit you? Why are you so angry?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Something happened in Diaz's community yesterday.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Something happened? What do you mean?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Haven't you heard? Their arts festival performance has been ruined.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Why does this sound like an accusation?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Miłosz asked me to persuade the community to push back their performance so that it doesn't conflict with your opening ceremony.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Right, I asked Miłosz to talk to you about it. So you think that... because you weren't amenable to the proposal, I asked someone else to do this.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I saw Miłosz talking to that captain several times when I was your bodyguard. His drug warehouse is under your name.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Looking at it now, your relationship isn't nearly as tense as it seemed. He's even on your ceremony's guest list.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I've had my suspicions that I didn't investigate, but now that this happened, I have to work out what's going on.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Tell me, Miss Ela, did you come to me with a prejudiced answer?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: No prejudices here. I want to hear your explanation.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: No... My communication with that man is not about cooperation. It's more... It's to watch him play the fool.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: So many have come up short when working against that community, and I was thinking perhaps he too would get a taste of his own medicine at their hands.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: That's the truth. It doesn't matter if you believe me or not, but I didn't order him to do this.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Maybe you didn't intend for this to happen... but did you think of the consequences beforehand?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: You sent a leader of an armed force to deal with a bunch of unarmed civilians.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: I never expected this to...

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Or maybe you never cared!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: You built this extravagant museum for the sake of your ego. Is that not enough? Why do you keep harassing people that have nothing to do with you? Over and over again?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Why? Do you really need any of this to prove yourself?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Enough, Miss Ela. It's time for you to leave.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Mr. Miłosz, I've been meaning to ask. How can you stand spending so much time around this monster?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Get out.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Enough, Miss Ela. If you insist on making someone the mastermind of this tragedy, then let's just say you have the man.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: But it's time for you to go.
The man turns and stands firm. Ignoring Ela, he shifts his center of gravity, twists his shoulder inwards, then swings his club elegantly.
The golf ball draws an arc in the sky, and although it should have landed roughly a meter from the hole, it strangely changes its trajectory midair and slips into the hole.
Ela picks up a golf ball from the basket and lifts it up under the sun.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: I noticed it a while ago. Doesn't matter how strange your trajectory is, your shots always land in the hole.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Mr. Miłosz, as the man closest to Reynell, can you tell me why?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Have you ever tried a single drive on your own merit, Reynell? Ever tried to draw a real curve in the sky?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Many times.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: How did they go?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: It's exhausting. There are no holes in the grass. It's a futile exercise.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Well, that's too bad.
Ela lets out a sigh and throws the golf ball in her hand. It tumbles in the grass for several revolutions before slowly drifting into the hole.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: How did it go? Is it done?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Good. Even the timing of the evacuation was perfect. This is the first time you've executed something so beautifully since I came to Dossoles.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Those four?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Don't worry about them. Didn't you put that punk out of commission?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: The whole community must be furious now. They can't stop them.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Now hurry up and get back here. We still have bigger fins to fry. Once this is dealt with, it'll be smooth sailing for both you and me.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: What do you mean half the force? We'll use all the forces at our disposal. This will make or break everything. Get it together.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Right, send everyone back to the Galería. Have them stand by for orders.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: The more the better. The cost is no object when compared to the potential profit.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Oh, and one last thing.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Remember to send a couple smart, glib-tongued fast runners to get those in the community riled up. We wouldn't want them to flame out disappointingly.

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Phew...
El Capitán breathes a long sigh.
Although the stage and seats have been set up outside the Galería for its opening ceremony, there is hardly anyone in attendance yet.

steps.name: Early-Arrival Tourist
steps.text: Huh? This is so boring. I thought there'd be something warming up the party if I got here earlier!

steps.name: Reluctant Tourist
steps.text: Still a few hours to go. Nobody's here yet! We didn't have to rush over!

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Early-Arrival Tourist
steps.text: What are you laughing about?

steps.name: Mateo
steps.text: There might just be a surprise for getting here early.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: That was heavy-handed of them. This is all I can do right now. It may be difficult for you to... perform more precise tasks with your right hand in the future.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Precise tasks?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Like writing or painting... Sorry.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: It's not your fault.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Remember to come get your wound redressed tomorrow.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: If only I had gotten down there just a minute sooner...

steps.name: Fuze
steps.text: Don't blame yourself. The people here are much faster and physically capable than us. It's not easy to give chase.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: I know that, but the officer did it right in front of me—

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Ela, you're back. What did Reynell say?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: He didn't order this, but that doesn't mean he's totally unrelated.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: What do you mean? Are you defending him?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Reynell contacted the captain and told him that as long as he could take care of the 'troublesome elements' in the community, he would get the development rights to the neighborhood.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: How is that not him giving the order?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: But he also told me that his goal was to see the captain make a fool of himself for offending him. He knows the people of the community are capable.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Why doesn't he come take a look at what happened to the place himself, then? How could he say that?!

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: Calm down, Kateb.

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Even if I could calm down, what about the people in the community?

steps.name: Doc
steps.text: Go take a look outside. How are they supposed to calm down once they hear Reynell's excuse?
The four of them feel a tremendous sense of despair as they walk amongst the crowd.
The members of the community sit despondent on the sides of the street, all of them look as though their souls have been sucked away.
Once, this was where they poured their enthusiasm, hard work, and inspiration, but there is nothing left here now.
Looking around, some are slowly lifting their heads up to stare at the blank expressions on each other's faces.
But more of them simply sit there, unsure of what else to do.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Ela, Ela!

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Tecno?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Is it Reynell? Is it that bastard who sent the Coalition assholes to lay waste to our hard work? Just for the sake of his opening ceremony?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Tecno... There are a few things we need to confirm first, but I don't think...

steps.name: Unfamiliar Community Resident
steps.text: You don't think what?! You used to be his bodyguard. Of course you're making excuses for him!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Community Resident
steps.text: An eye for an eye, I say!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Community Resident
steps.text: We should take to his Galería...

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Have everyone bring what's left of the festival. Once we're there, we'll smash that bastard Reynell's Galería with—

steps.name: Unfamiliar Community Resident
steps.text: You don't think that makes us look too weak?

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: Weak? What else do you want us to do?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Community Resident
steps.text: We should be charging the Galería to make Reynell and his secretary pay for this with their blood.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: (Quietly) There's someone in the crowd fanning the flames. Looks like somebody wants this escalated.

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Everyone, please calm down...

steps.name: Ailing Painter
steps.text: But... We probably can't take them on... I've had a bad back for years. I can't do violence.

steps.name: Weak Musician
steps.text: Me too. I have a herniated disk...

steps.name: Extremely Feeble Singer
steps.text: The only thing I can hurt anyone with is my sincerity. My body doesn't stand a chance.

steps.name: Sturdy Sculptor
steps.text: Well... I've trained for a few years, but I've got hemophobia...

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: (Quietly) Maybe things haven't gotten quite that intense just yet...

steps.name: Strange Community Resident
steps.text: We can't be this spineless, can we? Are we just gonna sit and do nothing after all they did to us?

steps.name: Weak Musician
steps.text: It doesn't sit right with me... Why is his opening ceremony allowed to go on after they destroyed our arts festival?

steps.name: Extremely Feeble Singer
steps.text: Papá... What do you think?

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: Come. Get your things. We're going to that glass building.

steps.name: Tecno
steps.text: We aren't actually going there to fight, are we?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Mr. Diaz, wait...

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: No, I'm telling you to bring your sound equipment and instruments... We lost our venue, so we'll use Reynell's Galería.

steps.name: Diaz
steps.text: They don't want to see us dancing? We will make them watch us dance.
A massive roar goes off. The crowd is suddenly riled up, like a pile of dry hay set alight by a match.

steps.name: Iana
steps.text: (Quietly) What do we do now...?

steps.name: Ela
steps.text: Let's... start by keeping an eye on them...

steps.name: Strange Community Resident
steps.text: (Quietly) Uh... Did we get the job done?

steps.name: Unfamiliar Community Resident
steps.text: (Quietly) No idea, but either way, they are going to the Galería.

steps.name: Strange Community Resident
steps.text: (Quietly) Report, the musbeasts have emerged from the hole.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Señor, where do I put this vase?

steps.name: Galería Security Officer
steps.text: Oh, that goes to Exhibition Hall No. 3.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Gracias.

steps.name: Galería Security Officer
steps.text: You're going the wrong way. Hall No. 3 is that way.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Perdón. I'm new here.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: (I've searched almost the entire museum. They've got heavy security detail everywhere except this area. I've racked my brains for so long, but none of my ideas got me inside.)

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: (Dammit. Even though all the leads pointed me here...)

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: (Someone's coming...)

steps.name: Galería Staff Worker
steps.text: The opening ceremony is about to start. Señor Miłosz requested everyone to leave the Galería and attend the opening ceremony in the plaza.

steps.name: Galería Security Officer
steps.text: What? Even us?

steps.name: Galería Staff Worker
steps.text: He was clear that not a single one of us is to stay in here.

steps.name: Galería Security Officer
steps.text: Alright... Let's go, hermanos.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Strange... Reynell is making everyone go to his conference...? What is he trying to do?

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: This place doesn't seem all that special either compared to the other places.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Maybe...

Ernesto takes out a few glass balls from his pocket and places them gently onto the ground. Although they should normally be stationary on a flat surface, they all begin to roll in the same direction.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: The floor is slightly slanted...

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: (Knocks on wall)

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Just as I thought. Here's a secret door.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Let me guess... Maybe this unremarkable painting?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: The conference will start in two hours, and some early arrivals are already seated. Have you decided what you're talking about during the ceremony?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Doesn't matter. It's all to buy us time, anyway. Let's just pick something from the proposals we got. That CVAP thing looks good to me.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: What will we use for the background picture of the presentation? A painting from the Galería?

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Use a picture of Mateo.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: If you humiliate him like that, knowing him, he'll likely have an outburst.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Why are you worried? I invited him exactly because I wanted to humiliate him. Besides, do you think I still care about his tantrums, after all this time?

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: His rage is nothing compared to the despair that those below will feel when the Galería explodes.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: The wealth that was invested into this place and the money-grubbing ambitions of the arts market... It's all going up in one big explosion.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: All that worthless trash sold at astronomical prices... Grotesque creations with their expressions and messages warped...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: True art left untouched in storage, only ever seeing the light of day when resold...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Look at what those greedy men have done to them. Now, these pieces will at last find a proper home in the flames.

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: The art market will be in chaos the next few years...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: That's what I want... Every time those investors think back on this day, they will shudder and quake...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: They'll see the true value of the arts, never again to be mere merchandise for trading.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: And the artists who suffer for it will finally be free of this market madness.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: It's a shame my mother and the old bones aren't here...

steps.name: Miłosz
steps.text: Reynell...

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Come sit with me a little, Miłosz.

steps.name: Reynell
steps.text: Let's wait for tomorrow together.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: So dark... There's not even a bit of light here...

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Good thing I brought a flashlight.

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: (Gulps)

steps.name: Tequila
steps.text: Wh-What's this...?
With the flashlight's beam, Ernesto finds packaging bags scattered across the hidden room's floor. The flammables inside are all neatly placed against the wall.
They are piled on top of one another, reaching all the way to the ceiling.
